title: galium parisiense subvar. anglicum
intro: Galium parisiense subvar. anglicum, commonly known as English Bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to act as a diuretic, help to reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of English Bedstraw involve its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and exhibit expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
